positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
• Eliminated a 3-hour stale-data window during regional failovers by re-architecting search into active-active, cross-region OpenSearch with SQS and Lambda, earning Capital One’s top resiliency tier
• Streamlined search onboarding time by 45% by moving to a config-driven retrieval, replacing code changes across five repos with one YAML file
• Reduced search latency by 42% to under 700ms by consolidating two OpenSearch calls into a single Lambda-orchestrated query
• Delivered greenfield ingestion pipeline in 3 weeks, indexing 5M+ records across 40 datasets for hybrid BM25 and vector search with AWS Glue
• Accelerated backfill runtime from 20 minutes to 10 minutes per dataset by raising publish throughput to 500 TPS, and automated daily runs through Airflow
• Halved greenfield API build time from 4 hours to 2 hours by creating Gantry, a multi-agent Claude framework that turns a PRD into a tested API, presented to 100+ engineers
• Hardened production releases by migrating to canary deployments with automated CodeDeploy rollback on CloudWatch error-rate thresholds
positions.insights: Skills: Python · AWS Lambda · AWS SQS · AWS CloudFormation · Amazon CloudWatch · Observe · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Glue · AWS OpenSearch · Claude Code

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
• Increased product engagement by 25% by delivering fullstack features using React, Node.js, and TypeScript, improving user flows across cloud-hosted UIs
• Reduced input-related user errors by 40% by building reusable components with consistent validation, improving form reliability across client and server
• Improved backend query performance by 35% by restructuring PostgreSQL schemas and refactoring high-cost endpoints supporting user analytics
• Enabled scalable deployment by integrating AWS Lambda, S3, and CloudWatch into backend services, supporting rapid iteration in Agile sprints
• Used Jest and React Testing Library to write unit and integration tests, supporting safe deployments and iterative releases
positions.insights: Skills: AWS Lambda · Express.js · Amazon CloudWatch · JavaScript · Node.js · Amazon S3 · React.js

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Increased audit compliance by 9% by implementing versioned encryption flows and resolving backend security vulnerabilities in enterprise workflows
• Developed scalable, accessible UI components using Angular and TypeScript, improving frontend consistency across enterprise workflows
• Raised test coverage by 40% by designing automated test cases with Robot Framework, improving regression safety and CI/CD confidence
• Delivered customer-facing features by collaborating with PMs and designers in Scrum teams, contributing across planning, implementation, and testing cycles
• Documented architecture and mentored engineers on frontend testing and security practices to reinforce shared ownership
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · PostgreSQL · SQL · TypeScript · Docker

projects.description:

• Analyzed and drew insights from large data sets using AWS Athena

Motion Picture Entertainment is an information source for films
